claim_summaries: Exact growing antiferromagnetic parameter sequence A_N=-(N+2)sqrt(N) I gives rho_N proportional to exp(-J^2) and trace distance at least 0.6220455-o(1) from every fully separable output, via a randomized-axis m=0 event and a uniform product anti-concentration bound.
The physical separation persists after adding a noncompact traceless anisotropy D_N=N diag(1,-1,0), by sector-tail domination.

A separate one-axis anisotropy A_N=sqrt(N) diag(1,0,0) has a macroscopic spin-radius variational maximum, so the compact critical N^(3/4) scale does not extend uniformly; this alone is not a nonseparability claim.
The fixed-bound finite-bit route has explicit sufficient budgets exponential in M^2 and B^2, but this is not an intrinsic algorithmic lower bound.
